label.explanation: event-processor crashes with an unhandled exception every time it processes msg-149432 at offset 598134, and on each restart resumes at that same committed offset (lines 156, 160, 164, 170, 174, 186, 187, 216). The restarts (lines 157, 159, 165, 169, 175, 183, 188, 215) run the same version v3.6.8 — not a deploy — and the lag (lines 182, 195, 204, 217, 226, 236, 243, 254, 260, 269, 275, 283) is the consequence. Skip/dead-letter offset 598134 and harden the handler. Red herrings: line 81 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full); line 134 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits); lines 116, 122 (a deploy of event-processor, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally).
